# Card

> A bounded container on the surface step with a hairline border; clickable as a whole only with the interactive class.

Part of the [Nate Mills Design System](../README.md). It is a CSS class API, not a JavaScript component, so its props are the classes and HTML attributes below. Link the stylesheets as [Getting started](../foundations/getting-started.md) shows, then add the classes. Every component: [Components](README.md).

## When to use

- A self-contained piece of content: a project, a credential, a metric, a quote.
- A whole surface that goes to exactly one place.
- An empty or error message in the place a card would sit.

## When not to use

- A row in a list: rows answer the pointer with a background wash, not a card lift.
- Content still loading: use a Loading card.
- A label or a status inside a card: use a Chip or a Badge.

## Alternatives

- **[Loading card](loading-card.md):** While the content is still on its way, show a Loading card; swap in the Card when it arrives.
- **[Button](button.md):** A card holding several actions stays static and puts a Button on each action. Only a card with exactly one destination becomes `.card--interactive`.

## How to use

**Element:** `<div>` or `<article>` for a static card; `<a href>` or `<button>` when the whole card is the target.

- Put `.card` on a `<div>` or `<article>`.
- When the whole card goes to one place, make the card itself the `<a href>` or `<button>` and add `.card--interactive`.
- For a message in place of content, add `.card--empty` or `.card--error`; on an always-dark slab, add `.card--dark`.

**Classes:** `.card`, `.card--dark`, `.card--interactive`, `.card--compact`, `.card--spacious`, `.card--empty`, `.card--error`

## Props

| Prop | Type | Allowed values | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tone` | modifier class | `dark` (`.card--dark`) | No class: the surface follows the page theme. | Which surface the card sits on. |
| `density` | modifier class | `compact` (`.card--compact`), `spacious` (`.card--spacious`) | No class: 24px padding. | Inner padding. |
| `interactive` | modifier class | `interactive` (`.card--interactive`) | No class: static, with no hover. | Whether the whole card answers the pointer. Put it on a real `<a>` or `<button>`. |
| `state` | modifier class | `empty` (`.card--empty`), `error` (`.card--error`) | No class: normal content. | A message in place of content. For loading, see Loading card. |

## Variants

Available tones: `dark`.

- `dark` (`.card--dark`): For an always-dark slab: ink surface, on-ink text and border, in both themes.

Default tone: No class: the surface follows the page theme.

Available densities: `compact`, `spacious`.

- `compact` (`.card--compact`): 16px padding.
- `spacious` (`.card--spacious`): 32px padding.

Default density: No class: 24px padding.

Available interactive values: `interactive`.

- `interactive` (`.card--interactive`): The one clickable-card hover: the border strengthens and the card lifts, with no fill.

Default interactive: No class: static, with no hover.

Available states: `empty`, `error`.

- `empty` (`.card--empty`): A centred empty message.
- `error` (`.card--error`): A centred error message carrying the feedback colour.

Default state: No class: normal content.

## States

The CSS styles these states: `:active`, `:focus-visible`, `:focus-within`, `:hover`.

## Invalid combinations

Options that must not be used together. Each names the props above.

| Combination | Level | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `interactive` on a `<div>` or `<article>` with a click handler | MUST NOT | Keyboard users can never reach it. The interactive card must itself be an `<a href>` or a `<button>`. |
| `interactive` with links or buttons inside it | MUST NOT | A control inside a link or button is invalid HTML. A card with several actions stays static. |
| `density: compact` with `density: spacious` | MUST NOT | The padding rules tie, so the padding depends on stylesheet order. |
| `state: empty` with `state: error` | MUST NOT | One card carries one message. |
| Any card with a `data-theme` attribute pinned on it | MUST NOT | The pin survives when the card is cloned and breaks dark mode. Use `tone: dark` for a dark slab. |

## Keyboard

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| Tab (interactive card) | Moves focus to the card, which is itself the `<a>` or `<button>`, and shows the focus ring. |
| Tab (static card) | Passes over the card and moves to the links or buttons inside it. |
| Enter | Follows an interactive link card, or activates a button card. |
| Space | Activates a button card; scrolls the page on a link card. |

These are the native keys of the element underneath, so they work with no script.

## Rules

| Level | Rule | Checked by |
|---|---|---|
| MUST | Make a whole-card target a real `<a>` or `<button>`. `.card--interactive` styles the hover; it does not make the card operable. | [Manual: Design review](../foundations/checks.md#design-review) |
| MUST NOT | Give a static `.card` a hover state; only `.card--interactive` answers the pointer. | [Automated: Mobile-consistency lint](../foundations/checks.md#mobile-consistency-lint) |
| MUST | Show the focus ring on an interactive card. | [Automated: Focus-ring gate](../foundations/checks.md#focus-ring-gate) |
| MUST | Keep text readable on an interactive card in hover, focus and press. | [Automated: State-contrast gate](../foundations/checks.md#state-contrast-gate) |
| MUST NOT | Give a card a drop shadow. | [Manual: Design review](../foundations/checks.md#design-review) |
| SHOULD | Change density with `.card--compact` or `.card--spacious` rather than a padding override. | [Manual: Design review](../foundations/checks.md#design-review) |

Automated checks run on natemills.me before every publish; the scripts live in the private source repository.

## Do and don't

### Do

- Give a whole-card target a real `a` or `button` element; `.card--interactive` styles the hover but does not make it operable.
- Use `.card--interactive` for the one clickable-card pattern; a full-width list row answers with a background wash instead.
- Reach for `.card--compact` or `.card--spacious` to change density, rather than overriding the padding in a page sheet.
- Keep the hover lift on `translate`, because the scroll reveal already animates `transform` and a running animation wins.

### Don't

- Do not give a static `.card` a hover state; only `.card--interactive` lifts, and the resting outline is the signal.
- Do not hang a click handler on a `div` card; keyboard users never reach it and no gate catches it.
- Do not answer focus with the lift; `:focus-within` fires on a mouse click and the card would jump on every press.
- Do not give a `.card` a shadow; the shadow tokens were deleted and depth in this system is carried by a border.

## Example

```html
<a class="card card--interactive" href="/work">
  <h3>Card title</h3>
  <p>One or two lines of body copy.</p>
</a>
```

## Look

- **Cards** sit on `{colors.surface}` with a 1px `{colors.border}` hairline and `{rounded.xl}`, padded
  24px (compact 16, spacious 32). Interaction is outline-plus-lift, not a background fill. Cards on a
  dark slab use the `card-dark` recipe, whose fixed ink and `on-ink-*` tokens keep it dark in both
  themes. Never pin `data-theme` on an element to force a look: the pin survives when the element is
  cloned and silently breaks dark mode.

Values in braces, such as `{colors.border}`, are named on the foundation pages, starting with [Colour](../foundations/color.md); every token with its purpose is on [Tokens](../foundations/tokens.md).

## Recipe

The recipe from [DESIGN.md](../DESIGN.md), one entry per state. Names in braces resolve on the foundation pages.

```yaml
card:
  backgroundColor: "{colors.surface}"
  textColor: "{colors.text-primary}"
  border: "1px solid {colors.border}"
  rounded: "{rounded.xl}"
  padding: "{spacing.card-pad-standard}"
  hover: "outline and slight lift, NOT a fill"
card-dark:
  backgroundColor: "{colors.brand-ink}"
  textColor: "{colors.on-ink-primary}"
  border: "1px solid {colors.on-ink-border}"
```

## Classes

| Class | Kind | What it does | Tokens it reads |
|---|---|---|---|
| `.card` | base | base; its heading takes the level of where the card sits (h3 under a section h2) | `--card-bg`, `--card-border`, `--card-fg`, `--card-padding`, `--card-radius` |
| `.card--dark` | modifier | on an always-dark slab; switches to the on-ink-* text family | `--card-dark-bg`, `--card-dark-border`, `--card-dark-fg` |
| `.card--interactive` | modifier | THE clickable-card hover: border strengthens and lifts, no fill | `--border-focus`, `--color-border-strong`, `--color-surface-sunken`, `--duration-base`, `--ease-default` |
| `.card--compact` | modifier | 16px padding | `--card-pad-compact` |
| `.card--spacious` | modifier | 32px padding | `--card-pad-spacious` |
| `.card--empty` | modifier | centred empty state | `--space-200` |
| `.card--error` | modifier | centred error state, carries the feedback colour | `--color-border`, `--color-feedback-background-error`, `--space-200` |
